routines.errorAssessment: Codes outside the safe signed hash range are wrapper input errors. With valid scalar IDs, capacities below two signal SPICE(STRINGTOOSHORT). A truncated UTF-8 scalar cannot be represented and the typed adapters raise a decoding error. Malformed pool associations have independent genuine errors BADSURFACEMAP, BADVARIABLETYPE, ARRAYSIZEMISMATCH and BLANKNAMEASSIGNED. Hash guards reject unrepresentable signed absolute values before the canonical lookup.

routines.fixtureRationale: The authored kernel supplies duplicate codes, names differing by body, and a numeric-looking mapped string. Dynamic pool assignments exercise precedence, cache invalidation and the actual retained hash state after a malformed-table diagnostic.
routines.cleanup: The workflow lifecycle tracks loaded kernels and clears session pool state. Read back translations before and after mutation, clear and reload. Shared shim collects and resets CSPICE errors. Native uses owned bounded strings and WASM releases temporary inputs, outputs and diagnostic buffers across failures.
routines.tolerance: Compare complete text, discriminated found/name flags and signed integer codes exactly. No floating tolerance applies to the returned data. Byte-prefix truncation is observed independently.

findings.summary: The N0067 integer surface hash computes signed abs before the modulus; INT32_MIN has no representable signed32 absolute value. Pool surface codes also enter this hash during table initialization.
findings.repair: The shared shim checks direct hashed surface codes and numeric pool values that round to INT32_MIN before translation under the existing serialized call. The independent oracle excludes the same unsafe domain. Defined numerical text parsing and safe neighboring IDs retain their canonical route.

findings.summary: After successful table initialization, replacing the numeric code column with character data consumes the watched update before BADVARIABLETYPE. Subsequent lookups can consult the previously built table until another watched mutation.
findings.repair: Retain actual cache behavior. The same-session focused test compares all four translation directions after the genuine refresh error and again after replacement, unload and reload. No caller-side replay, cache clearing or error fabrication.

findings.summary: High-level Python string conversion uses permissive decoding and strips trailing whitespace. Naive found handling can also obscure a successful decimal fallback with isName false.
findings.repair: The independent oracle calls the exact canonical routine into sized, canary-guarded byte storage and observes its separate output flag. Decode strictly up to the first terminator and compare the full result. Test names ending with a tab and legal small capacities.

routines.semantics: Resolve a surface name by its normalized spelling in the body-specific mappings. If no association matches, CSPICE parses the surface as an integer. The mapped numeric-looking name takes precedence over integer parsing. Return found:true with the actual integer code or found:false without a code. Resolve the body first. A numeric surface cannot produce a hit for an unrecognized body.
